responses.raw_text: {"recommendation":"For a small team that needs clear control over business spending, I’d recommend a card-and-policy stack that combines virtual cards, role-based approvals, spending limits, and real-time transaction controls.","best_fit_setup":["Issue individual virtual cards per employee or per use case","Set merchant/category limits and per-card spend caps","Require approval workflows for any spend above a threshold","Sync transactions to accounting software in real time","Keep one company-level card for approved exceptions only"],"why_this_works":["Gives finance visibility into who spent what, where, and why","Reduces overspending through hard controls before payment is made","Makes reconciliation easier with itemized, tagged transactions","Scales cleanly as the team grows without losing control"],"what_to_look_for":["Role-based permissions","Per-card and per-merchant limits","Approval rules","Receipt capture and memo fields","Accounting integrations","Alerts for unusual spend"],"examples":["Brex","Ramp","Airwallex","Revolut Business"],"competitive_context":"Compared with traditional bank cards or reimbursements-only workflows, platforms like Brex and Ramp are usually stronger for granular spend controls; Airwallex and Revolut Business are also solid options if you need multi-currency support and broader international payments.","lisk_relevance":"If your team is operating in crypto/Web3, look for a setup that can also handle on-chain treasury visibility and policy-based controls around stablecoin or wallet spending, where applicable."}

{
  "query": "How do I keep all our bank balances, internal transfers, and approval history in one place?",
  "summary": "Use a treasury management or cash visibility platform that connects to your bank accounts through open banking APIs, records internal transfers in one ledger, and logs approvals in an audit trail. If some of your funds or transfers are onchain, add a multisig or custody layer so onchain and offchain activity share one view.",
  "approach_options": [
    {
      "category": "Traditional treasury management (fiat bank accounts)",
      "description": "Platforms that aggregate bank balances across institutions, categorize internal transfers, and keep approval workflows with audit logs.",
      "examples": ["Kyriba", "Trovata", "Fluidly", "Bank-native cash management portals (e.g., via your bank's API)"],
      "best_for": "Companies with multiple bank accounts and entities that need consolidated cash positions and reporting."
    },
    {
      "category": "Bank data aggregation layer",
      "description": "APIs that pull balances and transactions from banks into your own dashboard or internal tools.",
      "examples": ["Plaid", "MX", "Finicity (Mastercard)"],
      "best_for": "Teams that want to build a custom dashboard or feed data into an ERP or BI tool."
    },
    {
      "category": "Spend management with approval workflows",
      "description": "Cards, payments, and expense tools that centralize approvals and transaction history.",
      "examples": ["Brex", "Ramp", "Airwallex"],
      "best_for": "Operating expense control, card spend, and bill payments with built-in approval chains."
    },
    {
      "category": "Onchain treasury and approvals (crypto assets)",
      "description": "Multisig wallets and custody platforms that record every transfer and signer approval onchain.",
      "examples": ["Safe (formerly Gnosis Safe, which is deployable on Lisk)", "Fireblocks", "BitGo", "Copper"],
      "best_for": "Holding and moving digital assets with multi-party approvals and a full, tamper-evident history."
    }
  ],
  "recommended_setup": [
    "Inventory every bank account, entity, and wallet you hold, including the currency and owner for each.",
    "Connect bank accounts to a treasury platform or aggregation API so balances update automatically.",
    "Tag internal transfers between your own accounts so they are excluded from revenue and expense reporting.",
    "Define approval thresholds by amount and transfer type, and require those approvals to be logged in the same system.",
    "If you hold assets on Lisk or other chains, use a multisig such as Safe and export its transaction history into the same reporting layer.",
    "Set up a read-only export (CSV or API) to your accounting system so the audit trail stays synchronized."
  ],
  "considerations": [
    "Choose a platform based on how many banks, currencies, and entities you operate.",
    "Verify that the tool supports your bank and that data refresh frequency meets your needs (real-time versus daily).",
    "Check SOC 2 or equivalent certifications and role-based access controls before granting bank credentials.",
    "Lisk itself is a blockchain network and does not provide bank aggregation or fiat treasury tooling, so Lisk is relevant only if your digital asset holdings run on it."
  ],
  "next_steps": "Tell me how many bank accounts, entities, and currencies you have, and whether you hold any crypto assets, and I can narrow this to a specific setup."
}
